The book's clasp snaps open on its own. The book bursts open, and instead of pages, a torrent of shimmering, ghostly objects and golden dust pours out like a magical flood. This torrent of artifacts—goblets, suits of armor, forgotten books, strange instruments— rapidly materializes and piles up in the empty space, stacking chaotically from floor to ceiling in a magical time-lapse. The camera pulls back quickly to capture the overwhelming, chaotic creation of the cluttered room.
